prerequisites: LC-6350 German 5 or LC-6360 German 6 or equivalent knowledge

learning_outcomes.text: be familiar with the main events of recent German history
have deepened your knowledge of technology, business, or arts in different eras
be able to discuss and write about these themes

syllabus_topics: Cultural knowledge of Germany from the viewpoints of technology, business and arts in the Weimar Republic
Cultural knowledge of Germany from the viewpoints of technology, business and arts during national socialism
Cultural knowledge of Germany from the viewpoints of technology, business and arts in the era of two Germanies
Cultural knowledge of Germany from the viewpoints of technology, business and arts during the reunification
Cultural knowledge of Germany from the viewpoints of technology, business and arts thereafter
